name: Bacon & Cheese Roll-ups
description: Crispy baked bacon-wrapped bread roll-ups filled with a creamy cheese mixture.
steps: Mix cream cheese and egg together until smooth.
Flatten bread slices and remove crusts.
Spread cream cheese mixture onto bread and roll tightly.
Wrap each roll with a strip of bacon.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until bacon is cooked and crisp.
